summary: The main article explores the use of MR-TADF compounds DiKTa and Mes3DiKTa as photocatalysts, comparing them to the benchmark 4CzIPN. It includes 7 tables and 2 figures detailing optimization, scope, and kinetic studies across various reaction types including reductive/oxidative quenching, energy transfer, and dual catalysis.
